resources.string: Your own gateway connects this app to Hakille. Use HTTPS, or 127.0.0.1 through an explicit local tunnel. Keep the desktop client disconnected while using the gateway.
Cancel waiting — result may be unknown
Request in progress. No automatic retry.
Microphone unavailable: native speech capture is not connected in this app.
Hold for 600 ms, then release to approve
Approve in two steps. Activate once to begin confirmation, then again after 600 milliseconds.
Older entries are omitted. Consult the journal.
On-device dictation, started only by this button. Text is added to the draft; review it before sending. This is not continuous wake-word listening.
Microphone permission requested. No capture has started.
Text added to the draft. Nothing was sent.
Dictation stopped. Tap Dictate to start a new session.
On-device dictation requires Android 12 (API 31) or later. No network recognizer is used as a fallback.
No on-device speech recognizer is available on this device. No cloud fallback.
Microphone permission denied. You can allow it in Android settings, then tap Dictate again.
Microphone permission is no longer available. Dictation has stopped.
The device recognizer is busy. Try again later.
Microphone capture failed. Check Android microphone access and your device.
This language is not available in the on-device recognizer. Choose an installed language.
No usable final text was recognized. The draft is unchanged.
Dictation stopped after 30 seconds. No unfinished text was added.
Dictation was discarded because the draft or session changed.
The recognized text is invalid or the draft exceeds 8192 UTF-8 bytes. Nothing was truncated or added.
The on-device recognizer failed. Dictation stopped without a cloud fallback.
Restoring the local draft and previous operation markers…
The saved local state cannot be read safely. No request will be sent. Keep app data for recovery; do not erase it if previous operation outcomes still need checking.
Local state could not be saved. Recent changes may be lost if the app closes. Check available storage; no new request can be sent until its state is saved.

A previous operation has an unknown outcome, possibly on another hub. Nothing is retried automatically. Check the hub journal before making a new attempt. Acknowledging this warning does not cancel the operation or confirm its outcome.
I have read this warning — archive it
The request was not sent: its local recovery marker could not be saved.
